completion: Submit the complete workflow-v10 five-slot structured research record and source evidence. instructions: Read the primary source in full. Produce a repository-quality structured research record covering problem, novelty, method, evaluation conditions, key quantitative results, limitations, implementation status, and relation to existing repository lineages. Preserve publication date/status, implementation and source URLs; for an arXiv paper, record its primary and cross-list categories from arXiv. Do not infer missing text from abstracts/search snippets. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. Follow workflow v10 fixed-slot transport; do not send completed Markdown from Scheduled Chat.
selection_reason: The gateway routes prompts with an edge SLM and separates routing from response generation; its primary abstract reports practical low-latency routing on edge hardware and improved efficiency versus using one model for both roles.
title: From Prompt to Service: An SLM-Based Agent Orchestration Gateway for AI-Driven Virtual Worlds
